Five ways to partner with Codility
Resell Codility assessments
For assessment providers and test delivery companies. Add Codility’s engineering and business assessments to your catalog and offer them to your clients alongside your own. Your clients get a technical library that their engineering teams respect, and you keep the client relationship.
Run Codility in the programs you design for clients
For talent consultancies, search firms and recruitment process outsourcing providers. Use one Codility standard in the hiring, early careers and capability programs you run for clients.
Measure the skills your programs build
For learning providers and certification bodies. Assess skills before and after a training program with real work tasks, so you and your clients can show what changed. Skills Intelligence reports results by skill for each person and each team.
Connect your platform
For HR technology companies. Connect your applicant tracking system, HR system or learning platform to Codility, so your customers send assessments and receive results without leaving your product. Codility connects with more than 80 applicant tracking systems, HR systems and scheduling tools today.
See the integrations directory
Refer clients to Codility
For consultancies, recruiters and platforms whose clients ask about technical or AI skills assessment. Introduce a client to Codility under a referral agreement, and our team takes it from there. Your client gets engineering and AI skills assessment built on a library of validated tasks.
